name: AdGuard dnsproxy (Open Source)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source DNS proxy server with DNS-over-HTTPS, DNS-over-TLS, DNS-over-QUIC and DNSCrypt; downloadable binaries and Docker image without vendor-enforced query or instance limits.
watch_out: You must operate your own DNS server, container or device and configure upstream resolvers and TLS certificates. Managed DNS hosting, compute, networking and any paid upstream resolver are not included; avoid exposing an unrestricted public resolver.
